title: Freshdesk Ticket Auto Responder
description: v12. Classify new inbound Freshdesk tickets and return routing metadata. The model no longer writes reply text; the Zap renders the fixed template from reply_template_key and customer_first_name.

type.description: Freshdesk ticket type. For auto-reply categories use exact values: status -> 'Where is my order?', cancellation -> 'Cancellation', return -> 'Return'.

blockers.description: Every hard blocker present anywhere in the ticket, including quoted emails. Empty array only if none apply. Any entry forces category none.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the classification, quoting the customer's words where possible.

tags_to_add.description: Tags for automation routing. Empty when no auto-reply should be sent.

should_auto_reply.description: True only when category is status, cancellation or return AND blockers is empty.

reply_template_key.description: Template selector for the Zap's render step. Null when should_auto_reply is false.

customer_first_name.description: Customer's first name exactly as they signed or stated it. Null if not clearly given.

ticket_status_to_set.description: Freshdesk status to set after auto-reply. Null when no auto-reply should be sent.

likely_order_number.description: Most likely order number explicitly mentioned in the ticket, or 0 if none.

confidence.description: Confidence 0 to 100 that the fixed self-serve template fully answers this customer.

do_not_auto_reply_reason.description: Short reason when should_auto_reply is false. Null when true.
